thread:
Iris (Design): Quick flag  compact trace card: corr-id chip + tiny download icon are jammed together. People tap the wrong one on mobile.
Ravi (EngRuntime): We get support pings. Download triggers heavy snapshot fetch so backend spikes.
Maya (Product): Do we know compact vs detail source for downloads?
Iris (Design): Analytics show ~30% start from compact cards last 30d. Proposal: make corr-id a single-tap copy and move Download into kebab menu. Add keyboard hint (focus + C).
Lee (Accessibility): Add aria-label on copy control, polite live region "Correlation ID copied", and ensure shortcut doesn't conflict. Kebab menu should use proper roles.
Noah (EngPlatform): Dev plan: roving tabindex, kebab after chip, menu navigable with arrow keys, Esc closes. Rate-limit downloads on client/server and show toast "Preparing download..."
Ravi (EngRuntime): For large traces return 202 and provide polling for export progress; require explicit confirm if payload > 5MB.
Maya (Product): UX tradeoff: hiding download may hurt discoverability. Maybe show subtle tooltip in compact view and keep prominent download on the detail page.
Iris (Design): I'll post two mocks: A) kebab-only with clear labels. B) small inline icon + first-click confirm. Will include a11y annotations.
Noah (EngPlatform): I'll own keyboard behavior and NVDA/VoiceOver testing.
Lee (Accessibility): I'll run a11y checks post-PR (keyboard nav, SR announcements, focus outline).
Iris (Design): Plan: final mock by EOD tomorrow, tagging @Noah @Ravi. :thumbsup:
